text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Every single lesson here at 
the Tracen Center is incredible, isn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Not only is the faculty exceptional, but 
the students are all so driven, too—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet, it is to surpass every single one 
of them that I came to the JRA Central. 
Together with you... leaving Funabashi 
behind for this place."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Together, you and I will 
definitely win, won't we?"
